links.outcome: Performance drop on external validation of ML prognostic models; ProgTOOL external validation performance
links.effect: ProgTOOL kept 86.5% balanced accuracy, MCC 0.78 and Brier 0.06 on 163 Helsinki patients. In the review, only 7 of 31 ML studies (22.6%) reported external validation, and most of those reported reduced performance.
links.quote: Most of the studies reported a reduction in performance when externally validated.

screen.reason: The study conducts an independent external validation of an existing clinical AI prognostic tool (ProgTOOL) on an independent cohort and couples it with a systematic review of external validation practices in the domain.
